essence: Delusion dense with suffering and error-chains, mirage-city-like: if it does not shine in consciousness-sky, no highest rest anywhere.
Dream's road unreal, deep sleep display, waking heap earth-firm — each passed beyond by knowing, none refuted from inside.
All lights in me, room-found in highest sky, shining undistinguished: I am He, infinite, true, free.
Time reckoned, creation created, love churning — play abiding in body; nothing unseen in delusion's evil.
Devour, slay, drink — whom, here, sir — frenzied in supreme-waking-abode-devouring.
Fear shattered, jackals scared, awakening once on wisdom's yoke: Rāmyadeva's non-difference-elephant trumpets.

rasa.dominant: śānta settling (wonder worked through to rest)
rasa.justification: Identity declared (so'ham), play permitted, otherness eaten, close set by another hand: the dialectic lands where it can stop moving.

sections.FUNCTION: From cosmology to identity to permission to devouring, ending in another's close.
sections.KEY TERMS: cidvyomni (consciousness-sky as the only seat); so'ham (I-He as found fact); krīḍāḍambara (play-pomp as permission); kavalīkaromi (I-devour as incorporation); abhedakaribṛṃhita (non-difference-elephant-trumpet as close-image); cakāstu/kāstu (may-shine/may-stand — fork adjudicated).
sections.LOCAL CONTEXT: The refutations done; delusion placed, states surveyed, identity declared, play permitted, otherness eaten, close set by Ramyadeva.
sections.BOUNDARY: The print variant (I devour vs whom) stays recorded, not adopted; the close stays Ramyadeva's, not Abhinavagupta's.
sections.EXPLANATION: Delusion gets its full weight — suffering-dense, error-chained, mirage-vast — then loses its last seat: unshown in consciousness-sky, it grounds nothing, not even for the many. Dream, sleep, waking each yield the same verdict: gone beyond by knowing, never refuted from inside. Then the turn: every light already in me, shining without division — He-I, infinite and free. Permission follows: time, makers, lovers all let be, the play at home in the body, nothing hidden even in delusion's evil. Then incorporation itself: devour, slay, drink — otherness eaten three times over. The close belongs to another voice: fear routed, jackals scattered, one awakening on wisdom's yoke, non-difference trumpeted.
